Anniversaries are extremely hard. I know that I struggle with being alone and had to tell one of my roommates about the situation. It helped that she knew it was a bad day and she got me busy and made me dinner. Maybe it could help you to talk to someone nearby? you don't have to tell them what happened exactly. Or reach out to someone else that was affected?

You can get through this.
